texts.value: Transcriptional repressor which preferentially binds to the GC-rich consensus sequence (5'-AGCCCCCGGCG-3') and may regulate expression of TNF, EGFR and PDGFA. May control smooth muscle cells proliferation following artery injury through PDGFA repression. May also bind double-stranded RNA. Positively regulates Toll-like receptor (TLR) signaling in response to agonist probably by competing with the negative FLII regulator for MYD88-binding
Homodimer. May also form higher oligomers. Interacts with FLII. Interacts with MYD88. Competes with FLII for MyD88-binding, even in the absence of LPS
The DNA-binding domain is intrinsically unstructured
